quarantine: Calibration transcripts, raw outputs, and score breakdowns are not copied into public fixtures or candidate prompts.

telemetry_surface.same_surface_requirement: All arms must use the same Codex rollout JSONL telemetry family, CLI version, budget accounting, and scoring-time truncation semantics; arm-specific home contents are part of the arm configuration and must be content-addressed.

arm_isolation_clarification.r3_same_execution_surface_meaning: Execution surface consistency means the same CLI family, CLI version, telemetry JSONL schema, budget accounting, and scoring-time truncation semantics. It does not require identical home contents across arms.

home_contents_are_arm_configuration.no-method: clean home with no AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md bootstrap, no solve-with-weilan skill, and no method-state runtime
home_contents_are_arm_configuration.append-only: frozen append-only control home with retrieval available and consolidation/supersession/collapse disabled
home_contents_are_arm_configuration.method-baseline: full method home/runtime as the deployed baseline configuration

arm_isolation_clarification.content_addressing: Each arm home composition and runner script must be content-addressed in the trial receipt; a no-method trial with method bootstrap or method-runtime operations is invalid under R6 arm purity.
